blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. All EVM deployments run verified Spiko Token code (Etherscan v2 verified; the 6,009-byte Token.sol core is identical across implementations 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74, 0x13ae01cbce8530012516fbc1273803d4995aee71, 0x60fcb8511db2a7b823cd0f3c6b08da456e18bff1 and 0x869dbfc8c578d7af77e0214287bb49d351d3e4e1). Token._update requires PermissionManager.canCall(from, token, 0xa9059cbb) for both sender and receiver (mint/burn exempt the zero side), so an issuer that revokes a holder's group removes that holder's transfer ability. At Ethereum block 26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z, hash pinned by RPC) the authority 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 (ERC-1967 proxy to PermissionManager 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e) returned getRequirements(token,0xa9059cbb)=65 (groups 0 and 6), canCall(whitelisted holder,token,0xa9059cbb)=true and canCall(0x...0001,token,0xa9059cbb)=false; a holder-to-non-holder transfer reverted with UnauthorizedTo(address,address) 0xb77a4ad1. Group 0 is held by 3/3 Safe 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea (getGroups=2^255+1), which can remGroup(holder,6); group-5 holder 0x71a1a4165ae953cb80fcd102c28fc5d03beafa24 can also manage group 6. The implementation also exposes restricted pause(), restricted burn(address,uint256) from an arbitrary holder, and restricted UUPS upgrade. Arbitrum authority 0xa925C217e4c1C82Ee721eBD496d3863D5C2d829A (proxy to the same PermissionManager, group-0 3/3 Safe 0x7843225ba488cf780a4fe2c842b5dc2abcf8a03e) and Polygon authority 0x344278... (group-0 3/3 Safe 0xa4196f06fe948b8ca81d3dc77110d3f83d10abd9) returned the same requirement=65 and reverted holder-to-non-holder transfers with 0xb77a4ad1 at Arbitrum block 516204261 (2026-10-19T06:17:20Z) and Polygon block 95790196 (2026-10-19T06:17:21Z). On Stellar, the token requires WHITELISTED_ROLE on both transfer parties and burns an arbitrary account when called with BURNER_ROLE; instance PERM is shared PermissionManager CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M. At Soroban ledger 65021030 (2026-10-19T06:22:13Z) has_role returned WLISTER Some(0) for GD2ELXTHZQORSH75SJE6XRTCKXNDGJFIZ4R2SZ4MMXDOBT52GK26X4EO and Some(1) for GAUYO4UAESQD6SGZDPOIG2ADT7EZTR5EJ7HSX4CYCWS2JMMGQOCL4QCX, BURNER Some(0) for redemption contract CAVZK26ERVGKGXLQGEOKPAQGIZS2YKN4BSXOYDMUY365EV66ZNSFEDBS, and its event history includes role_revoked|WLISTED. Materiality: measured totalSupply at 2026-10-19 summed across all seven deployments is 546,582,502,331 raw 5-decimal units: Arbitrum 412,822,130,363 (75.53%), Polygon 62,603,013,388 (11.45%), Starknet 49,436,962,434 (9.04%), Stellar 11,720,296,146 (2.14%), Ethereum 10,000,100,000 (1.83%), Base and Etherlink zero. The material Arbitrum and Polygon deployments are directly controlled; the sub-threshold deployments remain disclosed. There is no declared parent. Reserve composition is a cash-and-carry strategy; the reserve test is not reached because direct holder controls are established.

oracleRisk.summary: SPKCC's administrator-calculated NAV is published on Ethereum through the issuer-listed RedStone feed 0x9e37dbf40fe5fe9320e45fe6b95b000aa05459a9. At block 26236727 (2026-10-20T22:16:35Z, hash 0x1c50599154c5871ee9abf020d1ee94bc2cb1d544cc331f5bc2eceb20f3ab2adb), its implementation 0x14449cc3185dec0421c3cb37074215f1aacb97f9 matched verified EthereumMergedAdapterWithRoundsSpkccNavV1 runtime, SPKCC_NAV feed id, eight decimals and a three-of-five authorized data-signer model. The proxy remains upgradeable through admin 0x8223a6271d1e0bda019ee55d545d7b86eff1f573; authorized updater addresses relay signed data and are not themselves the signer quorum. Issuer-operated Spiko oracle contracts on other chains are distinct deployments. Standard external tier is retained, without inferring borrower liquidation paths, immutable pricing or complete feed-administrator custody.

branchApplicability.rationale: CACEIS calculates the fund-share NAV; the current issuer NAV registry maps the exact SPKCC Ethereum external feed separately from issuer-operated oracle deployments on other chains. Verified source and the 2026-10-20 pinned observation identify RedStone SPKCC_NAV at the exact Ethereum proxy. SPKCC is an NAV-accreting fund share without borrower-owned collateral positions, so the price-sensitive authority remains top-level-only and no collateral-liquidation branches are asserted.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: SPKCC has seven issuer-native fund-share deployments. The cited Spiko CCIP announcement explicitly concerns EUTBL and USTBL, not SPKCC. Exact SPKCC-specific cross-chain pool, peer, limits and controller evidence remains unresolved; native token identity does not establish a live transfer rail.
